## The Problem

Every markup refactor broke tests that had nothing to do with the change.

## The Approach

Score candidate selectors by stability, then **repair** a failing one from the last good snapshot.

| Selector kind | Survived refactors |
| --- | --- |
| class name | rarely |
| role + name | usually |
